name: perfume-platform
description: Full-stack perfume business management platform (inventory, CRM, sales, employees, accounting)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
